note: Squashfs-root sizes per strategy, produced by iso/scripts/measure-iso-store.sh. The squashfs root is the dominant term in the ISO because the offline container store is embedded inside it. Run 'just measure-iso' to fill the strategy rows; the baseline row (production settings) is the reference. Full-ISO byte counts reported by post-testing E2E / diagnostic runs live in docs/skills/ci-workflows/references/iso-e2e.md, not here, because they are a different metric (ISO minus the ~150-300 MiB ESP + boot files).

full_iso_reference.note: Full ISO sizes from CI for context; the harness measures the squashfs root only.
